verdict.rationale: Railway's own site claims you can roll back to any previous version instantly when something breaks, which covers the core of the story directly. The evidence is a single marketing line, and community items about the GCP outage say nothing about rollback, so they are ignored. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a one-click rollback flow (UI or CLI steps), any limits on which versions can be restored, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll back a deployed service to any previous version in one click

citations.quote: Rollback to any previous version instantly when something breaks.
